summary_en: Buffalo Inc. expanded its share buyback authorization from 11.2 billion yen to 14.0 billion yen on November 13, 2026, following better-than-expected Q2 FY2027 results. The 4 million share limit (16.9% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) and acquisition period through April 30, 2027 remain unchanged. The company aims to maintain capital efficiency with a consolidated ROE target of 15% or above.
title_en: Notice Regarding Partial Amendment to Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Expansion of Acquisition Limit)
translation_en_brief:
Buffalo Inc. announced on November 13, 2026 that it has expanded its treasury stock acquisition authorization. The maximum aggregate acquisition price has been increased from 11.2 billion yen to 14.0 billion yen, while the maximum number of shares to be acquired remains at 4 million shares (representing 16.9% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock). The acquisition period extends from May 15, 2026 through April 30, 2027.

The company initiated this buyback program in May 2026 with the objectives of enhancing shareholder returns, improving its balance sheet, and maintaining its status as a non-foreign investor under Japan's Foreign Exchange and Foreign Trade Act. The expansion was decided after the company's FY2027 second-quarter results exceeded forecasts, prompting management to reassess its financial capacity.

Buffalo emphasizes its commitment to capital-efficient management with a consolidated ROE target of 15% or above. As of October 31, 2026, no shares had been acquired under the May 2026 authorization. The company notes that the extent of acquisitions may vary depending on investment opportunities and market conditions.
